what: author declarations for issue #50 entries whose record printed the author's two name fields transposed
rule: an entry prints the record's own author strings; a declaration here is accepted ONLY when swapping the two fields of each record string reproduces the declared author, character for character after case/punctuation folding - so the declaration is a READING of the record rather than a correction typed over it. The build prints how many it applied and how many records it was offered.

linearspeedup2005.why: the record states its two name fields the wrong way round: it reads `A., Grigoriev` and `M.J., Uetz`, i.e. the family field carries the given name
